uniteDbPokemon.notes: Unite-DB public pokemon.json. v3 enumerates skills, boosted basic attacks, nested upgrade choices, Plus/enhanced effects, Unite Moves, and Unite Buffs.

sourceList.originalDescription: Dhelmise is granted a shield whenever one of the user's moves deals damage to Pokémon from the opposing team (5s cd). Each time this Ability or other effects grant the Pokémon a shield, the Pokémon's next basic attack deals increased damage. This effect can stack up to 3 times. When the shield granted by this ability expires after 3s, HP proportional to the amount of remaining shields is restored. 20% of the remaining shield value granted from Steelworker.
The user attacks by slamming their body. Dhelmise has no boosted attack.
No English description available in Unite-DB JSON.

Has the user swing their anchor, dealing damage and applying a 30% slow for 2s to opposing Pokémon hit. The user deals increased damage if Dhelmise was hit with an attack while this move is being used.

Has the user slash their anchor horizontally in front of themself, dealing damage, applying a 40% slow for 2s, and granting the user a shield for 3s. The edge of the anchor deals additional damage and leaves the opposing Pokémon it hits unable to act for 0.5s instead of slowing them.
Increases the duration opposing Pokémon are left unable to act to 1s.

Dhelmise swings their anchor diagonally, dealing damage and applying a 40% slow for 2s to opposing Pokémon hit. Every third time this move is used, it generates a whirlpool centered on the user for 2s, continuously pulling in nearby opposing Pokémon every tick. This move's cooldown is reduced by 0.8s every time Dhelmise hits with a basic attack. Dhelmise can auto attack and cast moves while the whirlpool is active.
Further reduces this move's cooldown by 1.5s every time the user hits with a basic attack.
Has the user shake the ground by slamming their anchor, dealing damage to opposing Pokémon and throwing them for 0.5s.

Has the user throw their anchor in a designated direction catching the first opposing Pokémon hit, dealing damage and leaving them unable to act. The user then pulls the target toward Dhelmise. Stun duration is 0.6s from close range, and 0.8s at max range.
Debuffs the targeted opposing Pokémon, increasing the amount of damage they receive from all sources by 50% for 0.8s or for as long as the target is being incapacitated.

The user lobs their anchor in a designated direction dealing damage to opposing Pokémon at the central point of impact and leaving them unable to act for 0.5s. Opposing Pokémon near the point of impact take damage and are slowed by 40% for 2s. The user then slams their heavy body down at the anchor's point of impact, dealing damage and applying an additional 40% slow for 2s to opposing Pokémon hit.
When the user slams their heavy body down, opposing Pokémon at the center of the point of impact are left unable to act for 0.5s.

Has the user throw their anchor and ensnare a designated Pokémon from the opposing team, dealing damage and leaving the target unable to act for 0.45s. The user then charges at the target, dealing damage and leaving them unable to act for 0.45s. If other Pokémon from the opposing team are hit by the anchor or the charge, they take damage and are shoved for 0.7s. Applies a cleansable damage over time effect to Pokémon on the opposing team that deals damage on hit and every 0.5s up to 9 times, healing Dhelmise with each tick based on damage dealt. The duration of the DoT is refreshed with each hit of the Unite Move. 150% of DoT damage
Buffs: 30% Movement Speed, 30% CDR, 20% Max HP Shield Buff duration: 6
